title: One-way ancillary booking: GetAncillary offers Baggage, Meal and Seat
expected: GetAncillary lists Baggage and Seat as well as Meal
expectation_quote: Retrieve available ancillary services (baggage, meal, seat, other) per passenger/segment, for suppliers/offers that support ancillary sales.

summary: GetAncillary returns only Meal items - no Baggage and no Seat (R1 claim, retracted in R3)
expectation_quote: Retrieve available ancillary services (baggage, meal, seat, other) per passenger/segment, for suppliers/offers that support ancillary sales.

second_opinion.summary: The FareConfirm offer advertises ancillaries and seats (offerHasAncillary=true, offerHasSeat=true). GetAncillary returns meals at segment level and baggage at journey level (No Bag 0, 20/30/40 Kg); seats come per passenger and segment from the separate SeatMap call, so baggage, meal and seat are all covered.

title: One-way bundle booking: Book applies selectedBundles
expected: totalAmount = pre-bundle total + bundle price, checked baggage per bundle
expectation_quote: the booking's final `priceDetails.totalAmount` should reflect the bundle's `feePrice` added to the base offer price

summary: Book accepts selectedBundles but does not apply the bundle (R1 claim, retracted in R3: bundles must also be sent on GetAncillary)
expectation_quote: the booking's final `priceDetails.totalAmount` should reflect the bundle's `feePrice` added to the base offer price

title: Bundle + paid meal booking: paxTotalAncillaryAmount equal on FareCheck, Book and Retrieve
expected: paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillary prices on Book and Retrieve
actual: Book 399.52 (meal 264.32), Retrieve 297.44 (meal 162.24) for the same PNR
expectation_quote: `paxTotalAncillaryAmount` (per §2.8's FareCheck example) should equal the sum of selected ancillary prices

summary: paxTotalAncillaryAmount differs between Book/FareCheck (399.52) and Retrieve (297.44) for the same booking (ADO 65507)
expectation_quote: `paxTotalAncillaryAmount` (per §2.8's FareCheck example) should equal the sum of selected ancillary prices

second_opinion.summary: FareCheck and Book list Meal VBY and Baggage 30 Kg, quantity 1 each, with paxTotalAncillaryAmount 399.52 EGP (264.32 + 135.20). Retrieve of the same booking (PNR 6RQFMU, Booked) has the same categories, quantities and codes, but the Meal price drops to 162.24 and paxTotalAncillaryAmount to 297.44, while priceDetails.totalAmount stays 5555.91 as on Book.
second_opinion.reviewer_caveat: Reads the FareCheck-time prices as the baseline for 'sum of selected ancillary prices'; would change if SPEC allowed Retrieve to re-price ancillaries.
